Title: Anil's Day

Cast

1. Anil - 30 years, son
Look: light beard, green T-shirt
2. Sonali - 64 years, mother
Look: red salwar-kameez
3. Nitin - 64 years, father
Look: blue shirt, black trousers
4. Sunita - 28 years, daughter
Look: green saree
5. Vinod - 26 years, friend
Look: white kurta-pyjama

Places

1. The hospital ward - white beds, a drip stand

Scene 1: The hospital ward - Day

[Anil stands in the ward. Sonali and Nitin stand near him.]

Sonali: "Nitin, what's the plan today?"

[Mother passes away, and Anil covers her body with a white sheet.]

Nitin: "We will never forget you."
